title: Bug 642638: [master] IRS 1099 reporting fields inconsistently stamped on Vendor Ledger Entries for non-1099 vendors - General Journal vs. Purchase Invoice
summary: IRS 1099 reporting fields on vendor ledger entries are now consistently left empty for vendors without a 1099 Form Box No., whether posted through a General Journal or Purchase Invoice.
key_points: IRS 1099 fields were being inconsistently stamped on vendor ledger entries for non-1099 vendors depending on the posting method
The fix ensures IRS data is only copied to vendor ledger entries when the vendor actually has a 1099 Form Box No.
Tests were added to verify that vendors without a Form Box No. get empty IRS fields from General Journal posting
This prevents non-1099 vendors from having incorrect and non-editable IRS reporting fields on their ledger entries
quote: Copy the IRS 1099 fields to the vendor ledger entry only when the vendor has a 1099 Form Box No.
